name: SSH Shared Jump Host - Mistyped Passwords Below Threshold
description: A shared internal jump host (one egress IP for many humans) where four different users mistype their password over ~90 seconds, and one then succeeds. This is the spray rule's dominant false-positive shape - many accounts, one source IP - held below the 5-distinct-account threshold. The DaC spray rule (100210) must NOT fire. Built-in 5716 fires per failure and 5715 on the success; that is correct and expected, because benign here means 'no rule of OURS fires', not 'silence'. This sample documents where the threshold sits: a busier NAT gateway WOULD cross it and needs a level-0 suppression child, not a higher threshold - see the rule's tuning_notes.
source: synthetic - modelled on sshd auth.log output
